text: Please accept this letter as my request for your support seeking the installation of temporary traffic lights on Morningside Bridge during the reconstruction work period as well as the installation of permanent traffic lights when the reconstruction work is complete along with a reduction of speed. The matter is urgent as a resident was recently struck on the Morningside Bridge due to the lack of a safe passage to the entrance of a city park, Morningside Park. Although new safety measures have since been implement the installation of traffic lights is paramount to the safety of pedestrians crossing at this area. Specifically as the summer months approach as Morningside Park is a highly utilized park and a safe pedestrian passing is highly required seven days a week.
Item SC31.26 was withdrawn from the agenda of the Scarborough Community Council.
